name: Ajooni
description: Surpassing personal conflicts, Ajooni and Rajveer embrace love. But with conspiracies brewing within the family, their relationship must stand the test of time.

videos.title: Meet the Fearless Ajooni
videos.overview: Brave girl, Ajooni teaches a lesson to a roadside Romeo with her befitting move. On the other hand, Rajveer resorts to violence to defend his territory.

videos.title: Ajooni Meets Rajveer
videos.overview: Rajveer saves Ajooni when she accidentally slips on the road. Elsewhere, Ajooni's family members start preparing for her marriage to Avinash.

videos.title: Love at First Sight for Rajveer
videos.overview: On seeing Ajooni, Rajveer feels an instant attraction towards her. Later, he arrives at her house for the Satyanarayan Pooja and gets furious to see her with a guy.

videos.title: Rajveer Proposes to Ajooni
videos.overview: Rajveer gets furious when he spots Ajooni with Avinash in a jewellery shop. Later, he buys an expensive ring and proposes to Ajooni.

videos.title: Rajveer at Ajooni's Engagement
videos.overview: Ajooni feels helpless when Rajveer forces her to take the dress. Later, he arrives at her and Avinash's engagement ceremony and creates havoc.

videos.title: Rajveer's Unsettling Demand
videos.overview: Rajveer storms into Ajooni's engagement venue and at gunpoint, asks her to marry him. When he creates chaos outside Ajooni's house, the police take him away.

videos.title: Rajveer Gets Released
videos.overview: After learning of Rajveer's arrest, Ravinder rushes to the police station. Ravinder, with his social power, forces Manjeet to release Rajveer from jail.

videos.title: Rajveer, Avinash's Face-off
videos.overview: Avinash gets into a fight with Rajveer as the latter announces his engagement with Ajooni. Later, Rajveer sends goons to attack Avinash in the hospital.

videos.title: Rajveer Is Angry with Avinash
videos.overview: Subhash reaches higher authorities to complain against Rajveer. Later, Rajveer decides to teach a lesson to Avinash after he finds Ajooni near his house.

videos.title: Rajveer's Diabolical Threat
videos.overview: After Rajveer kidnaps Avinash's sister, the latter breaks off his engagement with Ajooni. Later, Rajveer announces on a news channel that Ajooni is to get engaged to him.

videos.title: Rajveer Manipulates Bebe
videos.overview: When Bebe disrupts Rajveer's plans of marrying Ajooni, he cuts his hand and threatens to kill himself. Later, he stops Ajooni's family from leaving at gunpoint.

videos.title: Ajooni Agrees to Marry Rajveer
videos.overview: Ajooni gets worried about what Rajveer might do to her family and agrees to marry him. However, she asks Rajveer to publicly apologise to her family as a condition.

videos.title: Rajveer Threatens Ravinder
videos.overview: At gunpoint, Rajveer threatens Ravinder to accept his wedding with Ajooni. Bebe behaves harshly with Ajooni and her family when they arrive for the ceremony.

videos.title: A Clash at Ajooni, Rajveer's Wedding
videos.overview: Before Ajooni and Rajveer's wedding, both the families are at loggerheads. Rajveer keeps his promise to Ajooni and apologises to her family in front of everyone.

videos.title: Ajooni, Rajveer Get Hitched
videos.overview: After overcoming several obstacles, Ajooni and Rajveer finally get married. Later, Rajveer defends Ajooni when the Baggas humiliate her and want to change her name.

videos.title: Ajooni Makes it Clear
videos.overview: Ajooni takes a firm stand against the Baggas by refusing to change her name after marriage. Later, Ravjeer defends Ajooni when Bebe tries to slap her.

videos.title: Ajooni's Mooh Dikhai
videos.overview: The Bagaas host Ajooni's Mooh Dikhai ceremony at their mansion. While the guests face awkwardness, Rajveer whips the servant for breaking a precious gift.

videos.title: Neelu, Subhash Face Embarrassment
videos.overview: Ajooni informs Subhash about the occurrences at the Bagaa mansion. Later, Ravinder humiliates Neelu and Subhash for coming home uninformed.

videos.title: Rajveer Forces Ajooni to Apologise
videos.overview: Harman and Dolly demand Ajooni to cook non-veg food, but she refuses. Later, Rajveer forces Ajooni to apologise to Harman as Dolly instigates him.

videos.title: Ajooni's Ongoing Struggles
videos.overview: Ajooni has a hard time adjusting to her new family's rules and gets into constant arguments. Rajveer gets slapped by Ravinder while trying to protect Ajooni.

videos.title: Dolly's Foul Intent
videos.overview: To put Ajooni in trouble, Dolly puts chilli powder in her cooked food. Rajveer saves Ajooni from getting the punishment and endures the pain instead.

videos.title: Ajooni to Help Aman
videos.overview: Dolly fails to bring trouble into Ajooni's life after several attempts. Unable to endure the cruel treatment Aman receives from Harvinder, Ajooni tries to save her.

videos.title: Great News for Ajooni!
videos.overview: Ravinder punishes Harman and throws her out of the Bagga mansion. Later, the family is taken aback when Rajveer celebrates Ajooni's distinction.

videos.title: Rajveer Feels Ecstatic
videos.overview: Rajveer is on cloud nine as he celebrates Ajooni's triumph. In the meantime, Dolly and Surbhi lay a trap to frame Ajooni.

videos.title: Rajveer's Race Against Time
videos.overview: Dolly seeks revenge against Ajooni by playing a trick on her. Nonetheless, Rajveer rushes to Ajooni's rescue when she lands in a fix!

videos.title: Rajveer Is Knocked Senseless
videos.overview: Rajveer is unable to believe that Ajooni filed a case against Ravinder when the cops arrive at the Bagga mansion. Furthermore, Rajveer fights goons to save Mehr.

videos.title: Rajveer to the Rescue!
videos.overview: Dolly pays the price for attempting to frame Ajooni. On the other hand, Rajveer gets injured when he saves Mehr from a group of deadly goons.

videos.title: Ajooni Prays for Rajveer
videos.overview: Ajooni tends to Rajveer's wounds when his health condition deteriorates. She prays for his speedy recovery after she learns of his fight with the goons for her.

videos.title: Ajooni Faces Allegations
videos.overview: Concerned about Rajveer, Ajooni's family members visit the Bagga mansion. While the Baggas curse Ajooni, Rajveer's health worsens.

videos.title: A Miracle for Rajveer, Ajooni
videos.overview: Ajooni gets slapped by Harman as she is blamed for Rajveer's worsening state. Later, when she starts shouting, Rajveer responds and is declared out of danger.

videos.title: Ajooni Continues to Suffer
videos.overview: Ravinder makes Ajooni suffer and lose her self-esteem in order to stay at his house. Later, Mr. Sethi suggests that Ajooni should be given their party's ticket.

videos.title: Rajveer Exposes Dolly's Ruse
videos.overview: Rajveer accuses Dolly of hatching a devious plot against Ajooni and shares the evidence. When Dolly tries to frame Harman, Ajooni confronts her.

videos.title: A Shocker for Subhash
videos.overview: Subhash gets anxious when Ravinder and Dolly visit his house with a shocking appeal. Later, upon Rajveer's request, Ravinder withdraws all the conditions from Ajooni.

videos.title: Harman's Vindictive Motives
videos.overview: Harman orders the maid to put glass pieces in the laundry so Ajooni injures herself while doing the chores. Later, the Baggas urge Ajooni to start her family.

videos.title: Ajooni, Rajveer in a Conflict
videos.overview: Ajooni gets treated suspiciously after Bebe sees Rajveer sleeping on the floor. Though Rajveer tries to side with Ajooni, the commotion leads to a dispute between them.

videos.title: Rajveer Feels Jealous
videos.overview: Rajveer takes Ajooni to a special place with the intent of proposing to her. But he grows envious of Ajooni's chatter with her male friend and strikes him.

videos.title: Harman Annoys Ajooni
videos.overview: To teach Ajooni a lesson, Harman plans to trouble her. He asks her to wash the utensils in the bathroom and turns on the geyser.

videos.title: Dolly Pays the Price
videos.overview: Subhash raises his voice at Dolly for chewing a piece of gum in the class. While Mehr teaches Dolly a lesson for troubling him, Harman slaps Ajooni.

videos.title: Rajveer Helps Ajooni
videos.overview: To seek revenge, Harman and Dolly make an evil plan. Ajooni falls into their trap and gets hot oil splattered over her. Later, she accepts Rajveer's help.

videos.title: Ajooni Exposes Harman!
videos.overview: Chamko informs Ajooni that Harman has constantly desired to hurt her. Later, Ajooni confronts the family with the truth about Harman's horrible activities.

videos.title: Is Ajooni a Liar?
videos.overview: Ajooni is tagged as a liar after Chamko retracts her story, saying that she paid her to lie about Harman. As a punishment, Ajooni is forced to wash Harman's feet.

videos.title: Shikha Accepts Harvinder
videos.overview: Shikha and her parents visit the Baggas at their residence. Furthermore, Shikha likes Harvinder as their wedding gets fixed.

videos.title: Ajooni, Rajveer's Romantic Time
videos.overview: An intoxicated Harvinder dreams about his honeymoon with Shikha. On the other hand, Ajooni and Rajveer share a romantic moment at midnight.

videos.title: Harman Gets Caught
videos.overview: Harvinder gets angry at Aman as he becomes the victim of Harman's foul plan. Harman makes a silly mistake and gets caught before the Baggas.

videos.title: Dolly Consumes Vinegar
videos.overview: Rajveer goes into a romantic hallucination while Dolly accidentally drinks vinegar. Later, Ajooni takes Aman to the hospital for a test.

videos.title: Ajooni Reveals the Report
videos.overview: As Ravinder decides to call Sikha's father, Ajooni shows Aman's fertility report. Harvinder is unable to accept the truth and tortures Aman.

videos.title: Shikha, Harvinder's Outing
videos.overview: A heated conflict sparks between Harvinder and Rajveer as Ravinder reprimands their silly behaviour. Later, Shikha and Harvinder go out on a date.

videos.title: Rajveer Stands for Ajooni
videos.overview: Ajooni lashes out at Sikha as she abuses Aman. Later, when Ravinder urges Rajveer to punish Ajooni for her conduct with Sikha, he stands up for Ajooni.

videos.title: Ravinder Gives an Ultimatum
videos.overview: Ajooni identifies the doctor who checks on Aman's health condition. Later, Ravinder makes a startling announcement, regarding Harvinder's wedding.

videos.title: Good News for the Baggas
videos.overview: At Ravinder's birthday party, he announcesto the good news of Harvinder and Sikha's wedding, and Aman too, announces herpregnancy news. The Baggas celebrate the joy.

videos.title: Ravinder Rebukes Harvinder
videos.overview: After learning about Aman's pregnancy, Rajveer expresses his love and affection toward the unborn child. Later, Ravinder slaps Harvinder as he wishes to marry Shikha.

videos.title: Rajveer Loses His Temper
videos.overview: Dolly lays a cunning trap. Later, Aman gets an electric shock in the kitchen. When Dr. Avinash Khanna visits the Bagga mansion, Rajveer boils in rage.

videos.title: Harvinder's Promise to Shikha
videos.overview: Harvinder promises to kill Aman so he can marry Shikha. As per the plan, his henchman locks Aman in a lift and starts a smoke machine, getting him unconscious.

videos.title: Ajooni Discovers a Shocking Truth
videos.overview: Ravinder condemns Ajooni's carelessness and holds her responsible for Aman's condition. Later, Ajooni gets shocked to learn of Aman's lie about her pregnancy.

videos.title: Ravinder Lashes Out at Harvinder
videos.overview: Ravinder thrashes Harvinder proclaiming his involvement in the hospital mishap. Rajveer fumes in rage when he finds Ajooni and Avinash engaged in private conversation.

videos.title: Game Over, Harvinder!
videos.overview: The news of Aman's snakebite makes Ravinder certain about the conspiracy. Further, Harvinder gets caught as the hospital staff spill the truth.

videos.title: Rajveer Doubts Ajooni
videos.overview: Ravinder punishes Harvinder and Dolly for their crimes and warns them not to repeat them in future. Rajveer misinterprets Ajooni when he sees Avinash's text on her phone.

videos.title: Dolly, Harman's Notorious Act
videos.overview: Dolly and Harman's plan works as Ajooni's condition keeps deteriorating after the doctor injects a harmful substance into her body. Will Ajooni survive?

videos.title: Shikha Attains Her Target
videos.overview: Shikha creates a false scenario in which she attempts to end her life to persuade Harvinder to marry her. Meanwhile, Rajveer notices Ajooni and Avinash together.

videos.title: Ajooni Faces Harsh Repercussions
videos.overview: When Ravinder discovers Ajooni and Avinash together, he gets violent and imposes a severe penalty. Meanwhile, Rajveer is skeptical of Ajooni's innocence.

videos.title: Rajveer to Leave the House
videos.overview: Rajveer stops Ravinder from shooting Ajooni or giving her any punishment. Aman comes clean about her secret and Rajveer decides to leave the house with Ajooni.

videos.title: A Challenge for Ajooni
videos.overview: Ajooni gets shocked to learn about the messages, for which Rajveer misunderstands her. She takes up the challenge of finding the responsible within twenty-four hours.

videos.title: Ajooni Seeks Avinash's Help
videos.overview: Ajooni begs Avinash to assist her in establishing their innocence. However, Harman and Dolly continue to refine their strategy for their upcoming action.

videos.title: Ajooni Exposes the Truth!
videos.overview: Ajooni successfully uncovers the actual facts about how she was framed by Harman and Dolly. Moreover, Dolly reveals how she discovered Aman's truth.

videos.title: Ajooni's Unexpected Request
videos.overview: After punishing Harman and Dolly for their actions, Ravinder asks that Ajooni demand a reward. Ajooni then requests him to bring Aman back.

videos.title: Aman Attempts Suicide
videos.overview: While Harvinder throws Aman out of his room, the latter breaks down. Meanwhile, Harman makes a promise to Rajveer and requests to bring Ajooni to Bagga's house.

videos.title: Ravinder vs Rajveer
videos.overview: While Ajooni is away from the house, Harman gets punished for objecting to Rajveer's second marriage. Later, Rajveer and Ravinder compete in a challenge.

videos.title: Rajveer's Sincere Efforts
videos.overview: As Rajveer sneaks into Ajooni's room, the latter grows anxious and unknowingly hits him. Later, Rajveer makes a sincere effort to convince Ajooni.

videos.title: Bebe Slaps Harman!
videos.overview: While decorating the house, Rajveer saves Ajooni when she falls off the stool. Elsewhere, an infuriated Bebe smacks Harman for speaking ill about her.

videos.title: Harvinder, Sikha's Wicked Motive
videos.overview: Rajveer and Ajooni spent a blissful time together at Meher's birthday party. Meanwhile, Harvinder and Sikha plan to push Aman into the pond while she goes to fetch water.

videos.title: Rajveer, Ajooni Learn a Lesson
videos.overview: Rajveer plans a prank with Meher and tricks Ajooni into believing that he is having an affair. Later, Biji advises Ajooni and Rajveer to save their marriage.

videos.title: Ravinder's Shocking Move
videos.overview: Ravinder makes Dolly welcome Ajooni into the house and also asks her apologise to the latter by touching her feet. Later, Rajveer gives a romantic gift to Ajooni.

videos.title: Dolly Forges an Evil Plan
videos.overview: Despite Harmans warnings, Dolly devises a malicious ploy against Ajooni. Meanwhile, on the eve of Karwa Chauth, Rajveer and Ajooni begin to get closer.

videos.title: Ajooni's First Karwa Chauth
videos.overview: Rajveer displays his affection while performing Karwa Chauth rituals with Ajooni. Later, a conflict occurs when Harvinder demands a divorce from Aman.

videos.title: A Shocker for Ravinder
videos.overview: Ravinder gets astonished when Guru Maharaj informs him about Rajveer's shocking fate. Elsewhere, Rajveer grows suspicious when he gets attacked.

videos.title: Rajveer, Ajooni’s Romantic Moment
videos.overview: Romantic feelings seep in as Rajveer and Ajooni cherish each and every moment of their honeymoon. Elsewhere, Harvinder forges a wicked plot against Rajveer.

videos.title: Rajveer's Life at Risk
videos.overview: The Baggas feel worried about the troubled times in Rajveer’s life. In the meantime, a fan falls over Rajveer, and Ajooni seeks immediate help.

videos.title: Ajooni at Crossroads
videos.overview: Rajveer wishes to relive his honeymoon with Ajooni as their first one was cut short. Meanwhile, Harman pleads with Ajooni to keep a distance from Rajveer.

videos.title: Rajveer's Miraculous Save
videos.overview: To harm Rajveer, Harvinder sets a trap for him and poisons the arrow. In a twist of events, Harvinder gets hurt and is saved by Rajveer.

videos.title: Rajveer's Promise to Ajooni
videos.overview: While Rajveer gets ready for his first rally, Ajooni expresses her fear of him becoming a tyrant after joining politics. He reassures her and makes a promise.

videos.title: Ajooni Remains Steadfast
videos.overview: Ajooni holds her position, despite Guruji being infuriated with her for disagreeing with him. Enraged, Ravinder attacks Ajooni and threatens to punish her.

videos.title: Rajveer Worries About Ajooni
videos.overview: When Ajooni falls sick after the rituals, Rajveer takes care of her. Later, Harvinder tries to hurt Rajveer but Bebe catches him red-handed.

videos.title: Harman Makes a Promise
videos.overview: Bebe admonishes Harvinder after he gets caught while attempting to kill Rajveer. Later, Harman promises to get Aman and Harvinder divorced so he can marry Shikha.

videos.title: Harman's Vindictive Plan
videos.overview: Harman hides the divorce papers of Aman and Harvinder from Ravinder. Later, Harman poisons Aman's mind and asks her to hit Chamko with a stick.

videos.title: Aman Misunderstands Ajooni
videos.overview: Ajooni unknowingly makes Aman sign the divorce papers and Harman accuses the former of cheating on Aman. Further, Aman misunderstands Ajooni as Harman provokes her.

videos.title: Rajveer in a Risky Situation
videos.overview: Ravinder punishes Aman for the excess salt in the food. Mangi Ram tells Rajveer in the drunk state about the life risk of cohabiting with Ajooni.

videos.title: Chamko Instigates Aman
videos.overview: Aman aims to teach Ajooni a lesson and comes up with a plan when Chamko infuses venom into his mind. On the other side, Rajveer discovers Guruji's truth.

videos.title: Rajveer's Life at Stake
videos.overview: Rajveer tells Ajooni not to believe Maharaj's foretelling and to keep faith in their love. Later, the opposition party abducts Rajveer and shoots him in the conflict.

videos.title: Harman in Rajveer's Trap
videos.overview: Rajveer speaks out unexpectedly, while Harman sobs and declares Maharaj Ji's prophecy as a false one. Further, he questions Harman for troubling his marital life.

videos.title: Harman Pays the Price!
videos.overview: Rajveer castigates Harman's heinous conduct but refuses to punish her. However, Harman couldn't escape Ravinder's brutal anger and faces harsh repercussions.

videos.title: Rajveer to Harman's Rescue!
videos.overview: On Ajooni's insistence, Rajveer arrives to spare Harman from Ravinder's punishment. However, he refuses to forgive her and makes a crucial choice.

videos.title: Ajooni Ruins Harvinder's Plan
videos.overview: Ajooni thwarts Harvinder's plot when he brings Shikha dressed as Aman to the magistrate's office to complete the divorce. Aman apologises to Ajooni for mistaking her.

videos.title: Ajooni Stands Her Ground
videos.overview: Ajooni gives a stern reply to Bebe when she accuses her of ruining the Bagga's name. While Rajveer gets election tickets, the women protest against the Baggas

videos.title: Ajooni Reveals Harvinder's Truth
videos.overview: Ajooni confronts Ravinder about his aggressive demeanour and informs him of Harvinder's plot. However, Ravinder gives Ajooni a deadline to prove her claim.

videos.title: Ajooni Faces a Setback
videos.overview: Harvinder tricks Aman into taking the recorder that Ajooni has hidden. As it begins to play the song, Ajooni encounters a setback in front of Ravinder.

videos.title: Rajveer Takes Up a Challenge
videos.overview: Rajveer pledges to gather evidence to save Ajooni from Ravinder's harsh penalty. Meanwhile, Harvinder and Shikha team up to destroy the proof.

videos.title: Bebe Punishes Rajveer, Ajooni
videos.overview: Bebe decides to teach Ajooni a lesson, but Rajveer defends Ajooni. While Bebe punishes both Rajveer and Ajooni, the police deliver shocking news about Harvinder.

videos.title: The Baggas Get Shattered
videos.overview: Ajooni asks Rajveer to search for Shikha, as she was with Harvinder before the accident. The Baggas are devastated to discover Harvinder's fully burned corpse.

videos.title: Ajooni Faces an Accusation
videos.overview: After Rajveer brings ShikhaÂ to the Bagga house, sheÂ accuses AjooniÂ of killing Harvinder. Ravinder then decides to punish Ajooni after finding evidence against her.

videos.title: Rajveer Accepts the Charge
videos.overview: Rajveer brings along a witness to prove Harvinder's intent to kill him. After Ravinder lashes out at Rajveer, he confesses to killing Harvinder.

videos.title: Ajooni Confronts Rajveer
videos.overview: Ajooni faces Rajveer and briefs Shikha on her role in Harvinder's murder. Harman informs Ravinder of Rajveer's cooked-up story, after overhearing his conversation with Ajooni.

videos.title: Shikha Is Pregnant!
videos.overview: When Ravinder mistreats Ajooni for ruining his family, Rajveer brings evidence against Shikha. Meanwhile, Shikha's parents announce Shikha's pregnancy to the Baggas.

videos.title: Aman Loses Control
videos.overview: After Harman confirms Shikha's pregnancy, she convinces Ravinder to let Shikha stay at the house. However, an unhappy Aman tries to attack Shikha secretly.

videos.title: Ajooni Takes a Stand
videos.overview: Ajooni objects when Bebe and Harman decide to kick Aman out of the house. Meanwhile, Nari Morjya visits the Bagga mansion and demands punishment for Ravinder.

videos.title: Rajveer Misunderstands Ajooni
videos.overview: Upon the demand of Nari Morjya, Ravinder and Harman apologise before Ajooni and Aman. Later, Rajveer refuses to believe when Ajooni tries to clarify herself.

videos.title: Rajveer Stops Ravinder
videos.overview: Ravinder plans to shoot Ajooni to punish her for destroying his dream, but Rajveer tries to stop him. Later, the police bring Harvinder to Rajveer's house.

videos.title: Harman, Bebe Get Arrested
videos.overview: An officer from the Human Rights Association brings the cops to the Bagga mansion to question Ajooni. Her confession lands Harman and Bebe behind the bars.

videos.title: Ravinder Threatens the Cops
videos.overview: After Bebe and Harman are arrested, Rajveer holds himself responsible for the family feud. Later, Ravinder threatens the cops to release Bebe and Harman.

videos.title: Will Ajooni Withdraw the Complaint?
videos.overview: Rajveer begs Ajooni to dismiss her allegation against Harman and Bebe. However, despite being convinced, Ajooni offers to drop the allegations on one condition.

videos.title: Rajveer Confronts Ajooni
videos.overview: After being misled about Ajooni's intentions, Rajveer confronts her and gets Harman released. Later, Ravinder declares a punishment for Ajooni.

videos.title: Ajooni Presents Evidence
videos.overview: Shikha and Aman fight over serving food to Harvinder. Elsewhere, as Shikha's parents arrive, Ajooni offers evidence to reveal the perpetrator inside the house.

videos.title: Rajveer, Ajooni's Quality Time
videos.overview: Rajveer informs Ravinder of Bebe's fictitious acting after Shikha is ousted. Later, he apologises to Ajooni and the two of them have a good time together.

videos.title: Harvinder Challenges Ajooni
videos.overview: When Ajooni discovers Harvinder's truth, he challenges her to stop him from marrying Shikha. Later, Shikha uses Harvinder as the trump card for her plot.

videos.title: Harvinder Gets Caught!
videos.overview: To get a confession from Harvinder about the chandelier, Ravinder sets up a devious trap. Later, Ravinder swears that he won't let Harvinder marry Shikha.

videos.title: Harvinder Attacks Aman
videos.overview: Lying to Ravinder, Bebe and Harvinder go to Shikha's house to give her the jewellery. Later, Harvinder attacks Aman in order to make her sign the divorce papers.

videos.title: Ravinder Takes a Stand
videos.overview: Rajveer and Ajooni attempt to stop Harvinder and Shikha's wedding, but their efforts go in vain. Later, Ravinder refuses to let Shikha enter the house.

videos.title: Ravinder Fumes in Anger
videos.overview: After spotting a bruise on Amans neck, an infuriated Ravinder questions Harvinder. Later, he warns Bebe about her decision to bring Shikha to the Bagga house.

videos.title: Shikha's Diabolical Motive
videos.overview: Shikha deceives Aman by promising to give the baby to her as soon as it is born. During her Pehli Rasoi, Shikha tricks Aman into doing her part of the task.

videos.title: Ajooni Is Framed
videos.overview: Shikha accuses Ajooni of stealing, leaving the Baggas with no choice but to check her room. Surprisingly, the stolen item is found in her room.

videos.title: Ravinder Takes a Stand
videos.overview: Ravinder puts Shikha to the test in the kitchen to prove her lying about her abilities. Later, he takes action to prove Shikha's malice towards Ajooni.

videos.title: Ajooni Saves Aman
videos.overview: Rajveer remains baffled about Shikha's accusation against Ajooni. Further, Ajooni stops Aman from consuming poisonous milk after getting a warning note.

videos.title: Ajooni Faces Backlash
videos.overview: When Shikha drinks the glass of milk and remains harmless, Ajooni receives criticism from Ravinder. To keep Ajooni away from issues, Rajveer plans a vacation.

videos.title: Aman Faces Obstacle
videos.overview: Rajveer practises proposing Ajooni before they go out for the trip. Further, Shikha creates problems for Aman and makes her incensed before the Baggas.

videos.title: Rajveer, Ajooni's Romantic Moment
videos.overview: A mysterious man tries to abduct Ajooni but Rajveer manages to chase him down and rescue Ajooni. Later, Ajooni and Rajveer get romantic in their hotel room.

videos.title: Ajooni in Trouble
videos.overview: Aman confronts Harvinder as she hears his plan to put her in the hospital. As Ajooni and Rajveer spend quality time, an unknown person captures her and locks in room.

videos.title: Shikha Executes Her Plan
videos.overview: Shikha receives news from Harsh that he has trapped Ajooni in a secret chamber inside the hotel. While Rajveer tries to find her, Shikha asks Harsh to kill the former.

videos.title: Rajveer Finds Ajooni
videos.overview: Rajveer gets agitated as he hears Ajooni's voice but is unable to trace her. Despite the management's objection, he breaks the wall and finds her.

videos.title: Ajooni, Rajveer are Worried
videos.overview: Harvinder and Shikha hide Aman's body in the forest. Ajooni and Rajveer feel concerned and rush to Bagga's mansion after learning that Aman is missing.

videos.title: Ajooni Puts Shikha in a Spot
videos.overview: To expose Shikha's role in Aman's disappearance, Ajooni comes up with a scheme. Later, Shikha finds herself in trouble when her parents arrive

videos.title: Shikha Builds a False Story
videos.overview: Shikha fabricates a blatant lie to put Ajooni in a spot in front of everyone. Ajooni later devises a plan to teach Shikha a lesson when Ravinder arrives.

videos.title: Aman's Saviour Appears
videos.overview: Much to the surprise of the Baggas, Durga, Aman's aunt, shows up looking for her. While everyone gets tensed, she threatens Bebe and Harman.

videos.title: Ajooni's Firm Stand
videos.overview: Harman fumes in anger when Ajooni takes a firm stand and refuses to stand by her. Later, Harman furiously devises a vile plan to spoil Rajveer and Ajooni's movie plans.

videos.title: Ajooni Exacts Her Retribution
videos.overview: By making Shikha touch her feet and beg her to honour the request, Ajooni exacts her vengeance. Later, Shikha uses her evil scheme against Ajooni.

videos.title: Dolly's Misconduct is Exposed
videos.overview: Rajveer stands up for Ajooni and reveals how Dolly tried to embarrass her by substituting the meal. Later, Ravinder asks Shikha to slap Dolly as retribution.

videos.title: Durga Discovers Shikha's Pregnancy
videos.overview: Harvinder informs Durga about Shikha's pregnancy in order to conceal his affair with her. Durga later decides to look after Shikha until she gives birth.

videos.title: Ajooni, Rajveer Hatch a Plan
videos.overview: Ajooni and Rajveer plan to haunt Harvinder and Shikha and expose their heinous acts. To trouble Durga, Shikha intends to steal the former's inhaler.

videos.title: Shikha Gets Caught
videos.overview: Durga accuses Shikha of stealing her inhaler and searches her room. As Ajooni makes Shikha confess the truth, Durga gets determined to inform the police.

videos.title: Shikha Utters the Truth
videos.overview: When Durga sends Shikha out of the house, the latter speaks about her relationship with Harvinder. Harman finds Aman with Mahek and informs Ravinder.

videos.title: The Baggas Are Determined
videos.overview: Ajooni and Rajveer get startled as Harman and Bebe visit their house to search for Aman. However, Durga arrives in time to help Aman escape from the Baggas.

videos.title: Harman Is Punished
videos.overview: Harvinder punishes Harman for the humiliation he faced before Ajooni's family. Ravinder forces an inebriated Harvinder to confess the truth about Aman's ghost.

videos.title: Harvinder, Shikha Get Trapped
videos.overview: Rajveer and Ajooni prepare Aman to haunt Shikha and Harvinder. After witnessing Aman's spirit, Harvinder becomes alarmed and hurries to find her corpse.

videos.title: Harvinder, Shikha Get Exposed
videos.overview: Rajveer and Ajooni reveal Harvinder and Shikha's crime before the Baggas. Shikha tries to make up a tale, but Rajveer brings out the video of her confession.

videos.title: Ajooni Punishes Shikha
videos.overview: When Bebe obstructs Ravinder from punishing Shikha, he asks Ajooni to do it. Later, Ajooni seizes Shikha's rights and asks her to stay in the house as a guest.

videos.title: Harsh at Bagga Mansion
videos.overview: Ravinder is pleased to see Aman's new look and appreciates Ajooni for her idea. As Shikha refuses to speak with Harsh, he visits the Bagga mansion in disguise.

videos.title: Ajooni Gets Suspicious
videos.overview: Ajooni gets suspicious of Harsh's disguise and asks Mangiram to keep a close eye on him. Further, Shikha takes revenge on Chamko for troubling her.

videos.title: Shikha's Wicked Move
videos.overview: Ravinder strictly obstructs Shikha's participation in the Kul Devi Pooja with Harvinder. Later, to cause trouble, Shikha puts Ajooni's new dress in the dustbin.

videos.title: Ajooni Proves Her Love
videos.overview: To prove her love for Rajveer, Ajooni finds the dress in the garbage. Later, when Bebe wants to punish Ajooni, Rajveer creates obstructions.

videos.title: Shikha Gets Her Way
videos.overview: Shikha convinces Bebe that Ajooni tried to harm her and the latter declares that Ajooni's baby shower is cancelled. However, Durga takes a stand on Ajooni's behalf.

videos.title: Aman Falls Prey to Shikha's Plot
videos.overview: Shikha intoxicates the collector officer's drink, but Aman drinks it by accident. Soon, Aman loses her mind and starts acting insane, resulting in a shambles.

videos.title: The Baggas Celebrate Lohri
videos.overview: Ravinder rebukes Shikha for plotting against Aman. While the Baggas prepare to celebrate Lohri, Rajveer comes in the disguise of a dancer and dances with Ajooni.

videos.title: Shikha's Devious Move
videos.overview: As the Baggas play Antakshari, Ajooni confesses her love to Rajveer through a song. Meanwhile, Shikha devises a new ploy after receiving Dolly's letter.

videos.title: Ajooni's Firm Stand
videos.overview: As Chamko gives a befitting reply, Shikha hatches a plan against her. Later, Ajooni takes a firm stand when Bebe decides to throw Chamko out of the house.

videos.title: Dolly Gets Kidnapped
videos.overview: Harman plans to teach Shikha an apt lesson for her vile deeds. Elsewhere, Dolly gets kidnapped and is shocked to see the Baggas behaviour towards her.

videos.title: Dolly's Phoney Act
videos.overview: Executing her trap, Dolly gains Ravinders sympathy to get back into the Bagga house. Later she forges a vicious plan against Shikha.

videos.title: Ajooni's Smart Move
videos.overview: Ravinder gets impressed with Ajooni's clever move as she fixes his ruined Kurta with her sewing skill. Later, Ravinder issues a punishment to Shikha.

videos.title: Shikha Steals the Necklace
videos.overview: Shikha steals the necklace from Bebe's room and sells it to the goldsmith. Later, she gets shocked to see Harsh at the Bagga mansion and enquires about his visit.

videos.title: Neelu in Shikha's Trap
videos.overview: Shikha engages Neelu in a friendly conversation and puts the imitation necklace in the latter's bag. The Baggas get shocked to find the necklace in Neelu's bag.

videos.title: Ravinder Lashes Out at Shikha
videos.overview: Ravinder gets shocked to see the video of his house on the news channel. After learning about Shikha's involvement, he lashes at her and turns her out of the house.

videos.title: The Baggas Apologise to Neelu
videos.overview: The Nari Morcha team belittle Ravinder for defaming the women inside his house. Before the media, the Baggas apologise to Neelu for the false accusations.

videos.title: Ravinder Fumes in Anger
videos.overview: Ravinder gets angry when Dolly manipulates him against Shikha after the income tax raid. Rajveer takes a shocking decision when Ajooni breaks down.

videos.title: Ajooni Faces Bebe's Wrath
videos.overview: As per Shikha's villainous plan against Ajooni, the latter faces Bebe's wrath. On the other hand, Shikha meets a Tantrik to find a way to destroy the Bagga family.

videos.title: Ajooni Faces Accusations
videos.overview: Bebe and Harman bring the Tantrika home to save the Baggas from the ominous things. Tantrika accuses Ajooni of the consequences in the family.

videos.title: The Baggas in Trouble
videos.overview: The infuriated Tantrika wants to take revenge on Ajooni for the humiliation. The Baggas get worried after experiencing ominous events inside the house.

videos.title: Dolly's Evil Plot
videos.overview: Dolly seeks to take advantage of Tantrika to harm the Baggas as part of her nefarious plan. Afterwards, she hurts Ravinder by exploding a glass bottle.

videos.title: Bebe's Shocking Move
videos.overview: Upon Tantrika's order, Bebe decides to throw Ajooni out of the Bagga house. Ajooni is determined to leave the house instead of apologising to Tantrika.

videos.title: Can Badshah Help Ajooni?
videos.overview: Ravinder visits the Tantrika's cave and gets furious to learn about the latter's accusation against Ajooni. Rajveer and Ajooni seek Badshah's help to expose Tantrika.

videos.title: Tantrika's Scam Is Exposed!
videos.overview: To reveal Tantrika's deceit, Rajveer instructs Ajooni to step over the scorching embers. Later, Rajveer demonstrates each of Tantrika's deceptions.

videos.title: Rajveer Digs Deeper
videos.overview: Rajveer requests Ravinder to find the family member who is involved with Tantrika. When Harvinder appears, Ravinder accuses Shikha of causing all the trouble.

videos.title: Chamko's Sudden Change
videos.overview: After Chamko wins the lottery, she returns with a new look and denies being the Baggas' servant. Ravinder tells Bebe about the arrival of Dolly's prospective groom.

videos.title: Marriage Proposal for Dolly
videos.overview: Dolly gets a makeover from Ajooni before appearing in front of the suitor's family. In the meantime, Shikha commits a sinister deed by publicly framing Ajooni.

videos.title: Ajooni's Befitting Reply
videos.overview: Ajooni gives a befitting reply to Shikha when she insults Sundari. Shikha seizes the opportunity when Ajooni gets furious to see Sunadari and Rajveer together.

videos.title: Rajveer's Surprise for Ajooni
videos.overview: Rajveer plans a surprise dinner to calm Ajooni's anger, and they spend a moment together. Dolly is shocked to discover Harsh and Shikha's vile motives.

videos.title: Shikha Manipulates Harvinder
videos.overview: Ravinder decides to punish Dolly after learning of her wrongdoings. Shikha tries to instigate Harvinder to execute her heinous plan against Rajveer and Ajooni.

videos.title: Ajooni's Firm Stand
videos.overview: Ajooni is furious upon discovering Harvinder's abominable deeds towards Sundari. Later, the Baggas are astonished when Ajooni takes a firm stand for Sundari.

videos.title: Ravinder Makes a Decision
videos.overview: Ravinder gets infuriated by Harvinder's act and decides to give a fair judgement. While Shikha defends Harvinder, Ajooni briefs Sundari about the incident.

videos.title: Ajooni Feels Shattered
videos.overview: Ajooni is shocked as Sundari changes her statement and accepts her ill intentions. Rajveer gets into a tough spot when Ravinder asks him to give his verdict.

videos.title: Rajveer Lashes Out at Ajooni
videos.overview: Shikha wins Ravinder's heart and earns a special place at his house. Later, Rajveer bursts out in rage and blames Ajooni for all the humiliation he has faced.

videos.title: Ajooni Is Baffled
videos.overview: Ajooni saves Sundari from the goons and learns about Shikha's evil acts. Later, Ajooni gets shocked when her plan to prove herself to the Baggas backfires.

videos.title: Rajveer's Shocking Move
videos.overview: Ajooni falls into Shikha's trap and receives a harsh punishment from Bebe. But, Rajveer interrupts them and stuns everyone with his move.

videos.title: Rajveer Gets Abducted
videos.overview: Yash and Shikha get frightened about being exposed by Rajveer and they kidnap him. Later, Ajooni gets worried about Rajveer and rushes to Bagga mansion.

videos.title: Harsh's Dreadful Strategy
videos.overview: Shikha is terrified when Ravinder begins to doubt her, but Harsh invents a plan to kill Rajveer. Later, when Rajveer attempts to flee, Harsh strikes him again!

videos.title: Shikha Brainwashes Harvinder
videos.overview: Shikha plans to take advantage of Harvinder's emotions and brainwash him into killing Rajveer. Will Harvinder be swayed by Shikha's words to kill his brother?

videos.title: Rajveer Is Attacked
videos.overview: Shikha plans an attack on Rajveer, but Ajooni detects it ahead of time. Later, as Ajooni pursues him, the attacker holds Shikha at his knifepoint.

videos.title: Rajveer Loses His Memory
videos.overview: Rajveer gets an electric shock after Ajooni turns on the medical system. Later, as he regains consciousness he is unable to recognise the Baggas.

videos.title: Harvinder Gets Punished
videos.overview: Rajveer misunderstands Ajooni after getting glass pieces in his food. When Ravinder learns of Harvinder's inappropriate behaviour with Sundari, he punishes him.

videos.title: Rajveer Remains Perplexed
videos.overview: Ravinder arrives suddenly as Harvinder intends to throw an unconscious Rajveer from the terrace. Rajveer gets baffled about his enemy being inside the house.

videos.title: Rajveer Gets Attacked
videos.overview: Rajveer grows irritated as Ajooni tries to help him regain his memories. Meanwhile, Shikha and Harvinder plan an attack against Rajveer to clear their suspicions.

videos.title: Shikha's Foul Plan
videos.overview: After spotting her bangles, Rajveer accuses Shikha of making him unconscious. Further, Shikha plans to sow doubts in Rajveer's mind against Ajooni.

videos.title: Ajooni Is Framed!
videos.overview: Shikha attempts to persuade the Baggas, labelling Ajooni as the culprit behind all mishaps. To frame Ajooni, Harvinder places a pistol in her room.

videos.title: Rajveer Suspects Ajooni
videos.overview: Rajveer lies to Ravinder in order to save Harvinder. Later, Shikha manipulates Rajveer into believing that Ajooni is having an affair with Harsh.

videos.title: Rajveer Is Attacked
videos.overview: Rajveer shows his trust in Ajooni while Shikha forges a plan targeting him. Later, Harsh attacks Rajveer and makes him unconscious.

videos.title: Ajooni Locates Rajveer
videos.overview: While the Baggas search for Rajveer, Ajooni finds him inside the Holika. Later, Shikha sows doubt in Rajveer's mind against Harsh and Ajooni's relationship.

videos.title: Shikha Instigates Rajveer
videos.overview: While Ajooni mistakenly puts colour on Harsh's face, Shikha instigates Rajveer against the former. Shikha advises Rajveer to find a solution to punish Ajooni.

videos.title: Rajveer's Shocking Plan
videos.overview: A furious Rajveer hatches a plan to kill Ajooni. Shikha decides to follow Rajveer and Ajooni to destroy them together.

videos.title: Ajooni Gets Blamed
videos.overview: Ajooni breaks down in tears as Rajveer blames her for yet another fatal situation. Ajooni gets shocked when Rajveer questions her intention.

videos.title: Rajveer to Catch Harsh?
videos.overview: After getting attacked again, Rajveer rushes to catch the attacker and confronts Harsh. Later, Ajooni grows anxious when Rajveer furiously attempts to kill her.

videos.title: Rajveer Recovers Memories
videos.overview: Rajveer regains his memory while he attempts a fatal attack on Ajooni. Later, Ajooni and Rajveer plan to expose Harsh and Shikha's vile intentions.

videos.title: Shikha's Strategy Pays Off?
videos.overview: Rajveer tells Shikha that he murdered Ajooni and her lover. While Shikha is pleased that her strategy is bearing fruit, the Baggas maid, Kamli arrives.

videos.title: Rajveer Assists Ajooni
videos.overview: After learning about Ajooni's punishment, Rajveer secretly helps her with the work. Later, Ajooni follows the rituals and performs Rajveer's Aarti.

videos.title: Ajooni, Aman on a Mission
videos.overview: Ajooni and Aman chase after Shikha as she steals ornaments from the Baggas to give them to Harsh. Later, Ajooni discovers that Shikha falsely accused her mother.

videos.title: Ajooni Gets Emotional
videos.overview: Ajooni's parents get worried about her and leave the house in disappointment. Ajooni breaks down after the Baggas defame her character.

videos.title: Ajooni in a Tough Situation
videos.overview: Shikha notices Rajveer and Ajooni together and plans to cause trouble for the latter. The next day, Shikha accuses Ajooni of robbing the Baggas' belongings.

videos.title: Shikha's Plan in Action
videos.overview: During the political campaign, Shikha presents a video of Kamli and Rajveer's romance. Will Rajveer be forced to admit that Kamli is none other than Ajooni?

videos.title: Harman Gets a Responsibility
videos.overview: Ravinder brings a large box containing one crore rupees, and requests Harman to safeguard it. However, Shikha and Tejender resolve to steal the money.

videos.title: Rajveer, Ajooni Lay a Trap
videos.overview: Rajveer and Ajooni sow seeds of doubt in Shikha and Harsh's minds to extract the truth from them. Meanwhile, Tejender and his son enter the Bagga residence.

videos.title: Shikha, Harsh are Exposed!
videos.overview: Harvinder faces Ravinder's wrath after the bag having the money goes missing. Later, Harsh and Shikha's role in every single offence is revealed.

videos.title: Shikha Admits the Truth
videos.overview: Shikha confesses that the father of the unborn child is Harsh, and she goes on to disclose a startling fact about Harvinder. Eventually, Shikha gets arrested.

videos.title: Ravinder Comforts Harvinder
videos.overview: Harvinder is devastated by his health problems, but Ravinder gently soothes him. Later, the Baggas are perplexed by the news of the stolen money.

videos.title: Rajveer on a Mission
videos.overview: Ravinder gets a warning and a deadline for returning bankers money. Rajveer then takes up the challenge and heads to Tejender's house.

videos.title: Ravinder Loses Confidence
videos.overview: In order to further his goal, Rajveer challenges Shanky to a game. On the other hand, Ravinder is devastated at the prospect of quitting.

videos.title: Ravinder Teaches a Lesson
videos.overview: Tejender grows happy after Ravinder calls him to his house and seeks help. Soon after, Ravinder teaches him a lesson by forcing him to eat cash.

videos.title: Harman to Take Revenge
videos.overview: After Dolly instigates Harman against Ajooni, the latter wants to take revenge on her. Elsewhere, Shanky grows resolved to murder Rajveer in order to prove himself.

videos.title: Harman, Dolly Are Punished
videos.overview: Bebe becomes enraged and punishes Harman and Dolly for their plan of putting her in danger. Tejender gets shot when Shanky tries to kill Rajveer.

videos.title: Dolly's Plan Backfires
videos.overview: Dolly vows to teach Ajooni a lesson and places an electric wire under the gas burner. Unfortunately, Dolly herself gets an electric shock when she lights the burner.

videos.title: Amrit Takes a Shocking Oath
videos.overview: Rajveer finds a witness and visits Tejender's house to prove Shanky's crime. Amrit takes an oath to take her revenge and devises a plan against Ravinder.

videos.title: Dolly Frames Ajooni
videos.overview: Dolly fabricates a lie to Ajooni about having an affair with Bharat to cancel her wedding. Later, Dolly accuses Ajooni of provoking her to flee from home.

videos.title: Ajooni Proves Herself
videos.overview: Ajooni confronts Dolly and proves Bharat and herself innocent in front of the Baggas. Later, the family grows anxious when Dolly goes missing from the temple.

videos.title: Tejender Reveals a Shocking
videos.overview: Truth	Bharat kidnaps Dolly to give her a befitting punishment for her misdeeds. On the other hand, Tejender shocks everyone with a startling revelation.

videos.title: Ajooni Condemns Dowry
videos.overview: Shanky decides to visit the Bagga house to disclose Tejender's secret. Elsewhere, when Dolly's would-be in-laws demand a huge dowry, Ajooni firmly objects.

videos.title: Shankys Shocking Revelation
videos.overview: Shanky approaches Ravinder and accuses the Chaddas of being thugs. Adding more to his truth bombs, he claims to be Ravinder's son.

videos.title: Amrit, Tejender's Heinous Plan
videos.overview: After Kaveri's shocking revelation, Amrit and Tejender devise a plan to use Shanky against Ravinder. Meanwhile, Ravinder gives Shanky a chance to prove his claim.

videos.title: Ravinder Gets Worried
videos.overview: When Shanky tries to prove his claim, Tejender interferes and takes him away. However, Tejender and Amrit get happy, sowing doubts in Ravinders mind.

videos.title: Rajveers Fear Comes True?
videos.overview: Ajooni promises to bring out the truth about Rajveer's biological parents. Later, Rajveer gets shocked when he visits the hospital to collect the information.

videos.title: Ajooni Gives a New Idea
videos.overview: As Tejender's lawyer informs the Baggas that Rajveer owns their property, Ajooni advises conducting a DNA test. Will the Baggas agree to it?
